Welcome! We’re so glad you’re here.
High Valley Transit is the Wasatch Back’s public transit
network. We connect Wasatch, Salt Lake and Summit
counties with several public transit modes all powered
by technology.
Fixed route buses
Fixed route buses are high capacity buses that run on
a fixed schedule and along the same route every-time.
Seven routes run all day with wait times typically every
15-90 minutes and two commuter routes connect to the
basin with limited trips and stops.
Micro
Micro, short for microtransit, is an on-demand shared ride
service running throughout the Snyderville Basin and the
Heber Valley that allows you to book rides minutes before
you travel. It works like a mini van that comes to you —
book your ride in the HVT app and one of our custom
branded vans will come right to you to pick you up.
Use the High Valley Transit mobile app
to make the most of your time here.
If you’re looking for the fastest, easiest way to get where
you’re going, we’ve got you covered.
The HVT app lets you:
Plan your entire trip from start to finish — input your
pickup and dropoff addresses and the app will tell
you the fastest way to get where you’re going (bus,
Micro, or both).
Get detailed instructions on how to get to a bus stop.
View the real time location of your bus as it approaches.
